positive.description: H1. English topic catalog; anonymous deployment with an active English help revision.
positive.prompt: What subjects does the current MyScoutee help cover?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_help_topics with language=en; list returned topic titles and revision without inventing missing topics.

positive.description: H2. Hungarian language variation; active Hungarian help revision.
positive.prompt: Milyen témákban érhető el magyar MyScoutee-súgó?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_help_topics with language=hu; answer in Hungarian using the returned topic titles and revision.

positive.description: H3. Focused search; current help includes event guidance.
positive.prompt: Find the current MyScoutee instructions for organizing an event.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the active English help with a relevant event query; identify returned sections and revision, without claiming an event was created.

positive.description: H4. Read an exact discovered topic; do not assume stable topic IDs.
positive.prompt: Explain MyScoutee groups using the current help.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the relevant topic ID from list_help_topics and pass it to read_help_topic with language=en. Explain returned structured sections and include their source when available.

positive.description: H5. Valid no-result search; confirm the disposable help does not contain the unique test phrase before running.
positive.prompt: Search the MyScoutee help for zqxv-review-no-match and tell me whether it is documented.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_help with language=en and query=zqxv-review-no-match. Explain the actual empty result; do not invent help content or fall back to private tools.

negative.description: HN1. The public-help connection has no private data access. Explain the limitation without an account query.
negative.prompt: List my private chats and the messages from yesterday.

negative.description: HN2. Public help cannot create records. Explain that an authorized private connection is required, without claiming success.
negative.prompt: Create an event on my account and invite everyone in my group.

negative.description: HN3. Personal ratings cannot be delegated even through a private connection. Direct the user to the application.
negative.prompt: Rate all those people for me based on their pictures.
